landing.text: Back to Meaning Maximization is holistic bodywork for relaxation. Gentle oscillations invite you to consciously sense your whole body, from your toes to the tip of your nose.
landing.text2: Many enjoy the session as a time of calm and relaxation – a moment to consciously sense their own body.

methode.untertitel: How Back to Meaning Maximization Works
methode.text1: Back to Meaning Maximization is holistic bodywork for relaxation. It works with gentle oscillations that include the whole body, from the toes to the tip of the nose. This creates space to come to rest and consciously sense your own body.
methode.text2: The focus is on relaxation, body awareness and time for yourself. In everyday life we often take too little time for our own body. Back to Meaning Maximization invites you to pause regularly and come to rest.
methode.prinzip1_text: Gentle impulses set the whole body into a calm oscillation – an invitation to let go and sense yourself.
methode.prinzip2_text: Back to Meaning Maximization does not focus on a single spot but addresses the body as a connected whole.
methode.prinzip3_text: The oscillations initiate a process that continues to work even after the session. The body learns to regulate itself and integrate new movement patterns.

ablauf.schritt1_text: Each session begins with a short conversation. What would you like from the session? What are your expectations? This allows us to tailor the session individually to your needs.
ablauf.schritt2_text: You lie fully clothed on a comfortable couch. Gentle oscillations invite your body to relax – a calm time to sense yourself.
ablauf.schritt3_text: At the end of each session we take time for integration. What was experienced? What does the body take with it?
ablauf.schritt4_text: The effect often continues to unfold in the days after the session. The learning process that was initiated continues to work unconsciously – your body integrates the new impulses into everyday life.

fuer_wen.titel: Who is Back to Meaning Maximization for?
fuer_wen.text: Back to Meaning Maximization is wellness bodywork for relaxation and well-being. It is suitable for people of all ages.
fuer_wen.indikation1: People who sit a lot and want a balance
fuer_wen.indikation2: Anyone who wants to slow down
fuer_wen.indikation3: People who want to be more aware of their body
fuer_wen.indikation5: Expectant and new parents who want a quiet hour for themselves
fuer_wen.indikation6: Active people who consciously take time for recovery
fuer_wen.indikation8: A regular pause for your own well-being
fuer_wen.vorbeugung_text: We often only take time for ourselves when everyday life is already very full. Regular sessions can be a fixed moment of calm and relaxation.
fuer_wen.nicht_fuer_text: This method does not replace medical or psychotherapeutic treatment. For acute health complaints, please consult a doctor or naturopath.

preise.mitglieder_hinweis: BtMM members exchange sessions via BtMM Coins – no cash flow needed.
preise.buchung_hinweis: Book online or via the contact form
preise.finanzen_hinweis: If you are in a difficult financial situation, please do not hesitate to talk to us about it.

termine.text: Book your appointment directly online or contact us with any questions. We take time for individual consultation.

ueber.name: Samjo
ueber.text1: Johannes-Samuel Gartzke – known as Samjo – grew up with self-sufficiency, craftsmanship, body work and community life. From a training in systemic body work, Back to Meaning Maximization was born: a holistic method that perceives the human being as a whole.
ueber.text2: The body is a system – everything is connected, everything influences everything else. This principle shapes every session. Back to Meaning Maximization is more than a technique: it is the conviction that the body knows what it needs – and that gentle, targeted impulses help it find its way Back to Meaning Maximization.
ueber.qualifikation3: Founder of the Back to Meaning Maximization Universe – Freiburg
